messages.subject: Re: Which seeds to buy?
messages.text:
Hi Laurie,

Apologies again for how long this took, truly not acceptable on our end.

For your area and conditions, here's what I'd recommend:

- **Swamp milkweed (Asclepias incarnata)** is your best bet for shaded spots. It tolerates shade better than most milkweed species, handles both moist and drier soils, spreads more slowly than Common milkweed, and germinates fairly easily. It also works well in zone 6 (which is where Westchester falls).

- **Common milkweed (Asclepias syriaca)** does fine in zone 6 but really prefers full sun, it won't perform well in heavy shade.

- **Poke milkweed (Asclepias exaltata)** is actually the most shade-tolerant species we carry and is native to the Northeast, but it's currently out of stock.

So for your situation, Swamp milkweed (incarnata) is the one I'd go with. You can find our seed packets here: https://lasclay.com/en/products/milkweed-seeds

Note that we ship to the US, and seed orders ship by regular mail, no tracking number, usually 5 to 12 business days to arrive.

Let me know if you have any other questions!

Warmly,
